* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Vehicle: Ewok Glider, Endor, C
|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/ewokglider.html</ref>

Look, up in the skies! It's a vehicle! It's a weapon! it's both! This is a great little addition to any Ewok deck, and invaluable in booster draft where "weapons" make all the difference.

Firstly, this gives your Ewoks something they sorely lack, landspeed. A landspeed of 2 can really help when the site next door is starting to look like an AT-ST parking lot.

And it's primary ability is that it comes with it's own rocks, and no extra charge! What's more they are free to drop - that's cheaper than the Bow. It's a destiny - 1 weapon, but when you are only targeting pesky Biker Scout Troopers, a 3 (which most Ewoks are) will do fine. What's more, since it isn't a weapon, you can still hold a weapon in your free (?) hand!

And there's nothing like a Biker Scout with rocks in his head! Just remember the caveat, if the vehicle dies, the occupant goes with it.

Combo: This pesky little combo can exclude one opponent from battle, make another opponent power 0 and make a third opponent "hit". How many hands does this little guy have?
|combos=* [[Ewok Glider]] + [[Wicket]] + [[Ewok Spear]] This combo can exclude one opponent from battle, make another opponent power 0 and make a third opponent 'hit'.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Ewok%20Glider</ref>
